profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer/Lead/Architect
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software developer with broad experience in web and server development, deployment and configuration management, project leadership, technical presentation, and mentoring. I have particular
interest in back-end web services and technologies, domain-specific programming languages, and functional programming.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I am building marketplace integrations for a cloud-based monitoring, log analysis, and analytics platform used by IT operations teams, developers, and savvy business users.

positions.title: Back End Engineering Lead
positions.description: I joined a small, elite team of engineers to help revolutionize the world of online education, and over time helped grow the Engineering organization to over sixty engineers. Much of my work involved guiding and reviewing the work of team members, at first across all back-end systems, later across several core services and our PaaS infrastructure. Work focused on core backend functions and PaaS infrastructure, first using Python on the Google App Engine platform, then moving to Go for back-end services and microservices.

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: I started at PayPal as a nearly entry-level software engineer and concluded as one of the leaders of the engineering and operations organizations. Highlights: led the development of the payment system for eBay Express; migrated the development organization to a new operating system; architected the overhaul and standardization of deployment tools and process, introducing the use of Puppet for configuration management. Work has involved everything from front-end HTML templates to back-end database layer design and implementation, from user-facing applications to tools and infrastructure. Work on web applications and refactoring done in C++, using largely proprietary libraries and technologies. Work on internal tools done in Ruby, Puppet, Python, bash, and Perl.

positions.title: Organist / Handbell Choir Director
positions.description: Also served as choir accompanist. Work here included a mixture of pipe organ, piano, electric bass, percussion, handbells, and singing, covering everything from plainchant to modern Christian pop, from Bach to African chant. The Rev. Todd Jolly was the choir director.

positions.title: Developer Technical Support Engineer
positions.description: Answered technical queries about development in BeOS; developed sample code and newsletter articles; wrote code for third parties developing applications and libraries on BeOS; developed and presented all-day sessions for Be developer conferences. Later: managed for a short time a team of engineers supporting developers and hardware vendors for the new BeIA media/internet appliance platform.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Completed development of a DOS and UNIX schematic entry tool for ASIC, MCM, and MEMS design, then led a project with five engineers to port it to Windows. Tools: Watcom C, Visual C++, gcc, gprof, Insure++, MFC, Mainwin

volunteerExperiences.description: TEALS aims to get more, as well as more diverse, computer science and programming graduates, by engaging with them at the high school level. I am volunteering as a part-time instructor for an Intro to CS class that uses the programming languages Snap! and Python.
